independent_review.source_institution: Institute for Diagnostic and Interventional Radiology, Hannover Medical School
independent_review.observed: Bilateral heterogeneous pulmonary opacities, particularly basal, with intensive-care devices and preserved R side marker.
independent_review.license_read: README explicitly includes master-, image- and laboratory-data under CC BY 3.0; LICENSE Attribution 3.0 Unported. Not inferred from software license.
independent_review.clinical_fit: Pass for existing DX3 text: radiographie peut montrer ... opacités bilatérales. Initial plan pneumothorax target must explicitly be replaced for this image.
independent_review.suggested_caption: Radiographie thoracique de face, incidence antéropostérieure : opacités pulmonaires bilatérales, notamment basales. Cliché issu du jeu de données COVID-19 de la Hannover Medical School ; l’image seule ne détermine ni la cause ni la gravité d’une insuffisance respiratoire.

annotation_review.assessment: Broad areas correspond to opacities but lower left-lung contour can include mediastinum/diaphragm. Prefer simple arrows to clearly pulmonary opacities, avoiding device lines, rather than diagnostic segmentation.
annotation_review.lateralization: Patient right is image left as confirmed by R marker.

research.access_issue: Initial urllib GET HTTP503; ordinary curl GET of exact same URLs succeeded via unchanged proxy. No access bypass.

render_and_caption_review.inspection: All four named screenshots actually visually inspected; specification read. Desktop initial/bottom views together show comparison, both numbered definitions, caption, limitations, attribution, source and licence. Mobile initial/bottom views show stacked comparison and lower caption/attribution; intermediate mobile scroll position not inspected.
render_and_caption_review.medical_overlay_assessment: Tightened contours localize pulmonary basal opacities. No obvious excursion over diaphragm or mediastinum in inspected desktop rendering. Marker 1 corresponds to patient right on image left; marker 2 to patient left on image right. R marker remains visible on both versions. Device lines remain visible.
render_and_caption_review.comparison_assessment: Original and annotated image use concordant framing/orientation. Number badges partially cover local pixels, but unobscured original is presented alongside on desktop and above on mobile. Acceptable as reading landmarks; not segmentation.
render_and_caption_review.caption_assessment: Definitions describe opacity morphology and explicitly avoid treating contours as exact lesion boundaries. COVID context attributed to source series. Non-specific nature, AP projection, reduced resolution, superimposed devices and inability to determine respiratory failure/ARDS/severity from isolated radiograph are explicit. No overclaim of pneumothorax or effusion.
render_and_caption_review.rights_rendering: Visible attribution names Hinrich B. Winther et collaborateurs, Hannover Medical School, repository, DOI, CC BY3.0 and links Source/Licence; source authorship independently checked by root, not newly verified through DOI by this reviewer.
render_and_caption_review.mobile_assessment: Readable stacked images and text; lower attribution fits narrow screen. Modal clipping at viewport boundary is normal scroll behavior, as evidenced by separately inspected bottom capture. Did not personally exercise browser controls.
render_and_caption_review.scope: This reviewer changed only RADIO_2044.json. No HTML, image, global or git modifications.
